events.title: Next Fest Update!
events.summary: Thanks to everybody that's been playing! I've made a few more changes based on player feedback and data, it's very helpful! First and most importantly, I've made it so early talents unlock quite a bit quicker and you can earn slightly more of them in the demo.I've decreased the amount of xp required for early levels, and added a number of new achievements that players should earn on their first run through, win or lose. events.title: Demo Update!
events.summary: Thanks for everybody that has played and given feedback on the demo! I have been making small tweaks and balance changes here and there, but also got two very important pieces of demo feedback. First, some of the keystone talents were broken specifically in demo builds. This is fixed!
